profile.belief: I grew up in the middle of Catalina Island with only ten other houses, surrounded by bison and dirt roads. Through this isolation, tv became my tunnel to the outside world and I would make up stories as I wandered around the island. I’d look over the water on clear nights and see this sparkling city of LA that I dreamed to work in, and knew that was where I was meant to be.
profile.working_on: My ultimate goal is to be a full time actor.
